gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link ExtraFieldUtils}, the helper that parses, merges and registers ZIP "extra field" records.
ADDED i4: A class implementing ZipExtraField with a no-arg constructor registers cleanly.
ADDED i6: A negative offset corrupts parsing and is wrapped into a ZipException.
ADDED i9: Build an array mixing several concrete extra-field types, ending with an UnparseableExtraFieldData holder which is treated specially.
ADDED i11: A lone trailing UnparseableExtraFieldData holder contributes no bytes.
ADDED i12: Two header-id bytes ("up" = 0x7570) followed by a zero length.
ADDED i13: A 4-byte record whose declared length leaves it unparseable is kept as raw data when READ is used, then merged back to the same 4 bytes.
ADDED i16: declares a 35-byte block but only 4 bytes remain
ADDED i19: The dangling 13th byte cannot form a 4-byte header, so 12 bytes are merged.
